sector.description: A silent transmission station overlooks the plain.
sector.notes: GM secret: the backup generator can power the signal lamp. All demonstration mechanics are fictional.

special.overview:
The main hall, equipment room and water tank form a small compound.

Supplies (fictional demonstration): 2 clean Grub, 3 clean Water; no Bullets.
special.situation: A stranded group is deciding whether to repair the transmitter or leave.

locations.title: Main hall
locations.details: Tables and empty lockers line the walls.

locations.title: Equipment room
locations.details: A sealed cabinet holds spare components.

inhabitants.title: Nara
inhabitants.details:
Nara repairs the station.

Motivation: restore contact with her family.
